courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 傅立葉轉換紅外光譜儀
related.transfer: 可遷移「積分球的輻射交換原理」與「替代法校正與自吸收修正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；傅立葉轉換紅外光譜儀的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Radiative exchange inside the integrating sphere" and "Substitution calibration and self-absorption correction" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Fourier-transform infrared spectrometers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦球倍增因子、塗層與開口、替代法校正與總光通量不確定度；傅立葉轉換紅外光譜儀則以麥克森干涉儀、氦氖取樣、解析度與訊雜比交換的 FTIR 工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on sphere multiplier, coating and ports, substitution calibration and total-flux uncertainty; Fourier-transform infrared spectrometers centres on michelson interferometer, HeNe sampling, resolution and signal-to-noise trade-offs in FTIR engineering, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「朗伯漫反射壁面與球倍增因子」與「麥克森干涉儀與干涉圖」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到傅立葉轉換紅外光譜儀，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「雜訊、掃描次數與解析度的交換」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Lambertian wall and the sphere multiplier” and “Michelson interferometer and interferogram”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Fourier-transform infrared spectrometers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Noise, scan averaging and the resolution trade", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 積分球輻射量測
history.text: 1892 年 Sumpner 提出以漫反射球腔量測總光通量的原理，1900 年 Ulbricht 建造實用的「烏布利希球」並用於燈具光通量量測，積分球因此在歐洲常以他命名。二十世紀中葉國際照明委員會（CIE）將替代法與自吸收修正寫入光通量量測技術報告，1979 年成立的 Labsphere 在 1980 年代推出燒結 PTFE 漫反射材料，使可見到近紅外的壁面反射率達到 0.99；近年 LED 照明普及，CIE S 025 等標準與 NIST 的總光譜輻射通量刻度把積分球量測推向光譜化與更低的不確定度。本課只重建公開原理與量測程序。
history.textEn: In 1892 Sumpner proposed measuring total luminous flux with a diffusely reflecting spherical cavity, and in 1900 Ulbricht built the practical Ulbricht sphere for lamp flux measurement, which is why the device often carries his name in Europe. In the mid-twentieth century the International Commission on Illumination (CIE) codified substitution and self-absorption correction in its luminous-flux technical reports; Labsphere, founded in 1979, introduced sintered-PTFE diffuse material in the 1980s, raising wall reflectance to 0.99 from the visible to the near infrared. With the spread of LED lighting, standards such as CIE S 025 and NIST's total spectral radiant flux scale have pushed sphere measurement toward spectral methods and lower uncertainty; this course reconstructs only public principles and procedures.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型

history.text: 本課把「積分球的輻射交換原理」到「追溯、比對與量測系統交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
